newsitem.title: USA: Negotiated muni sales to total $218 mln Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Negotiated muni sales to total $218 mln Tuesday.

text.p: Scheduled negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $218 million in 12 offerings for Tuesday, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
The largest is a $55 million Wisconsin Health and Education Finance Authority revenue bond issue through Ziegler Securities.

An additional four deals totaling $124 million are on the Reuters possible calendar for Tuesday, meaning underwriters have said they may decide to price the issues depending on market conditions. --U.S. Municipal Information Group, 212-859-1826
